report.question: Does lagged weekly range beat a purged training-median baseline on the selected UCI archive panel?

GIG parses selected weekly observations and excludes future-label/dividend columns; these changes are not UCI or exchange outputs.
dataset.reason: CC BY 4.0 source weekly equity aggregates; retrospective diagnostics only, not adjusted or PIT-admitted returns.

metrics.score_units: fraction of source weekly opening level

bootstrap.method: circular moving blocks over weekly cross-sectional mean loss differences
bootstrap.limits: Only 15 held-out weeks; descriptive uncertainty, not independent confirmation.

skeptic.review_independence: Separate Decimal transforms and Python median/loss reference; same source, not independent economic confirmation.
skeptic.reason: Small retrospective selected panel; unknown adjustment, historical universe and publication clocks. No return or alpha claim.

report.design_status: EXPLORATORY_NOT_PREREGISTERED; fixed five-label software research sample, not an investment universe.
report.training_boundary: One purged week; expanding training-only median; lag feature from completed source week.
report.interpretation: Retrospective range error 0.019236 versus 0.012863; lower is better. Small selected archive panel, no economic claim.

multiple_testing.scope: Two fixed UCI questions, not all historical research.

failure_conditions: Corporate actions and adjustment basis unavailable.
Historical publication and membership evidence unavailable.
Only five source labels and 25 weeks; no survivorship-free universe.
